import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SerreTwist

/-!
# Nonzero sections of a trivial bundle

When the ring of global functions is a field, every nonzero morphism from the
structure sheaf to a trivial line bundle is invertible. In particular, a global
section which generates on a nonempty open generates everywhere.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{0}} {L : X.Modules}

/-- Over a scheme whose global functions form a field, a nonzero section of a
trivial line bundle trivializes that bundle. -/
theorem isIso_unit_hom_of_ne_zero (hX : IsField Γ(X, ⊤))
    (e : L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (s : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ L) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    IsIso s := by
  letI : Field Γ(X, ⊤) := hX.toField
  let t := s ≫ e.hom
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht
    apply hs
    apply (cancel_mono e.hom).mp
    change s ≫ e.hom = 0 at ht
    exact ht.trans (zero_comp).symm
  have ha : Grassmannian.unitEndSection t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    apply ht
    rw [← Grassmannian.scalarEnd_unitEndSection t, ha, Grassmannian.scalarEnd_zero]
  haveI : IsIso (Grassmannian.scalarEnd (Grassmannian.unitEndSection t)) :=
    (ProjTwist.unitScalarIso (Units.mk0 _ ha)).isIso_hom
  haveI : IsIso t := (Grassmannian.scalarEnd_unitEndSection t) ▸ inferInstance
  exact (isIso_comp_right_iff s e.hom).mp inferInstance

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Local invertibility on a nonempty open implies global invertibility for a
section of a trivial line bundle when global functions form a field. -/
theorem isIso_unit_hom_of_isIso_restrict (hX : IsField Γ(X, ⊤))
    (e : L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (s : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ L)
    (W : X.Opens) [Nonempty W]
    [IsIso ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)] : IsIso s := by
  apply isIso_unit_hom_of_ne_zero hX e s
  intro hs
  have hid : (𝟙 ((restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_mono ((restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)).mp
    simp [hs]
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty W›
  letI : Nonempty (W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) := ⟨⟨x.1, ⟨x, trivial, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  have hone := congrArg
    (fun f => f.val.app (op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) hid
  change (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)) = 0 at hone
  exact one_ne_zero hone

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
